effects.name: evidence-heads
effects.source: the Vouch store's evidence heads and their verified chains (state.json and the event objects), read by check.evidence-anchors and by each workflow's head-listing step
effects.capture: the check's verdict and per-head detail rows, and the workflow's NAME@VERSION list; nothing is written by reading

effects.name: ci-anchor-advance
effects.system: the project's Vouch store and its default branch, through the CI anchor job
effects.detail: for each listed head (no run claim, or an anchor that differs from its head) runs advance-anchor with the exact reference under the workflow run claim, then regenerates projections, runs check --ci and commits .vouch/ as the anchor bot; a head already anchored at its head under a run claim is not listed
